entities.name: Igort Uriklatz
entities.description: Owner of 22 registered pets who broke the Azorius Leash Laws.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild that enforces the Leash Laws.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: Guild whose officers handled the rampaging ogre.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: Guild of the member who helped create the Leashling.

entities.name: Orzhov

entities.name: Leash Laws
entities.description: Law requiring all pets to be leashed at all times.

events.summary: Igort's ogre breaks free and rampages through the streets until Boros officers handle it.
events.quote: It rampaged for a short while until Boros officers easily handled it.

events.summary: Igort is arrested; after a three-and-a-half-year trial he is fined and loses his license and all 22 pets to the Simic.
events.quote: Igortz received a fine, lost his pet license, and lost all 22 of his pets to the Simic .

events.summary: Igort creates a Leashling with an Izzet guild member.
events.quote: Igortz then later created a Leashling with an Izzet guild member.

relations.note: Ran afoul of the Azorius Leash Laws
relations.quote: ran afoul of the Leash Laws of the Azorius guild
